news.title: Nation Sim
content: We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest game, Nation Sim! Dive into a world of strategy and diplomacy as you build and manage your own nation, from resource management to international relations.

features.title: Nation Sim is ready to play:
items: Build and manage your own nation in a deep simulation sandbox.

news.footer: The game is out now on itch.io.

news.title: Castle Wars Update 1.2
content: Get ready for our biggest update yet! Castle Wars 1.2 brings new levels and a completely revamped combat system that will change the way you play.

features.title: Update 1.2:
items: 5 New Levels: Explore new castles and battlefields.
Revamped AI System: Experience more dynamic and strategic battles.

news.footer: The update is scheduled for release on November 1st!
